input.title: Dedupe drops legitimate same-day, same-amount repeat transactions
input.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

dedupeKey only uses date, amount and description, so two genuinely separate transactions that happen to share all three (e.g. two identical coffee purchases on the same morning) collapse into one row. The dedupe pass should distinguish repeated identical rows within a single upload (which are legitimate) from rows that reappear because of an overlapping statement re-upload, for example by tracking how many times a key has already been seen in this batch versus in previously stored transactions, rather than treating any repeat as a duplicate after the first.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

Duplicate detection keys a row only on date + amount + description (see dedupeKey in src/ingest/dedupe.ts). It's meant to catch the same statement being re-uploaded or two statements overlapping by a few days, but it can't tell that apart from two genuinely separate transactions that happen to share all three fields, like your two coffees. The first occurrence wins and the second identical row is silently dropped from the report. This needs fixing so repeated identical rows within one upload aren't collapsed unless they're actually re-appearing from a previously-seen statement.
